entries.title: Insult
entries.description: Direct insulting language toward the religion or its sanctities.

entries.title: Mockery
entries.description: Ridicule or sneering treatment of sacred matters.

entries.title: Desecration
entries.description: Treating holy matters or spaces with disrespect.

entries.title: Incitement
entries.description: Urging hostility, hatred, or sectarian division.

entries.title: Glorification
entries.description: Praising harmful or abusive conduct toward religion.

entries.title: Misrepresentation
entries.description: Presenting religion or its figures inaccurately or unfairly.

entries.title: Defamation
entries.description: False or harmful derogatory assertions about religious figures or groups.

entries.title: Hate Speech
entries.description: Speech intended to degrade or attack religion or its adherents.
